status: Prepared and peer-reviewed; hardware validation owned by root and not claimed here.

discovery.v1_observed: B_CLK /2 write/read succeeded; B_CTRL desired40802000 read40801400 before UPDATE, causing immediate-check rejection. Exact old-state rollback succeeded. DCDC3/DCDC4 setpoints both900mV, phase0, feedback0, both A76 offline.
discovery.interpretation: Observed old N is specified manual-update behavior, not proof of a failed write or inadequate voltage.

facts: Only N and LFM use manual UPDATE; before UPDATE, N reads the committed old value.
UPDATE is invalid when PLL_EN is off. Updates must be separated by at least1us.
Cold enable order: LDO, OUTPUT, factors, PLL_EN, LOCK_ENABLE, UPDATE, wait clear, three lock observations,20us.
manual_reference.donor_crosscheck: ccu_nkmp_set_rate retains desired reg in software and writes reg|clear rather than recomputing N from pre-commit readback.
manual_reference.manual_inconsistency: Non-LFM steps repeat UPDATE and describe waiting LOCK clear. Use donor set_rate single commit, bounded UPDATE clear, committed CTRL/CTRL_STAT factor verification and LOCK set checks; do not copy ambiguous text literally.

v3.peer_review: event_review confirmed complete cold sequence, cached N, CTRL/STAT commit validation, active-PLL upgrade, safe retained-N rollback and post-rollback guards.

changes: Pre-commit writes verify immediate gate fields and the exact previous committed N; they do not pretend desired N should read back yet.
Commit writes cached desired|UPDATE directly with ENABLE on and1us delay; after clear both CTRL and CTRL_STAT must match the desired configuration.
Enable416 follows the documented cold sequence; target N32, VCO832MHz, external/2.
Upgrade1014 keeps PLL_EN on while CPU selects slow: output/lock detector off, cached N39, detector on, commit, lock/20us, output on, mux last.
Any failure reduces to slow and disables PLL without committing N while disabled. Accepted retained factors are N20/32/39; all other stopped bits must equal40800000, CTRL=STAT, CLK=0 and CPU_SLOW=0.
No attempt is made to run an out-of-range N20 VCO to cosmetically recover the original factor.
All mutations require CPU6/7 offline with cpus_read_lock; owner PMIC checks before and after target remain800..1100mV with no voltage writes.
Guard changes still force offline/reset, including a second guard check after rollback.
preserved_v1_v2: Historical source and modules unchanged; do not use their pre-UPDATE immediate N check as the active experimental path.
